title: A Facile and Eco-friendly Route to Fabricate Poly(Lactic Acid) Scaffolds with Graded Pore Size
protocol: Grind NaCl in a laboratory blender for 20 min.
Dry ground NaCl on a heater at 100 °C.
Sieve dried NaCl (45 g) using a sieving machine at the highest frequency without resonance for 30 minutes.
Collect six salt fractions ranging from 500 µm to 100 µm as specified.
Vacuum dry all collected materials overnight.
Select appropriate drying temperatures: T = 90 °C for PLA, T = 25 °C for PEG, and T = 105 °C for NaCl.
Mix PLA, PEG, and NaCl in a batch mixer at T = 190 °C and n = 60 rpm until torque value stabilizes.
Collect resulting material after achieving constant torque value.
Prepare mono-layers using a laboratory press operating at 210 °C.
Place blends into cylindrical molds with diameter of 10 mm and height of 3 mm.
Press molds for 60 sec at ambient pressure and then 3 minutes at 180 bar.
Cool blends to room temperature while maintaining 180 bar pressure.
Prepare each single layer using molds having a diameter of 10 mm and a height of 1 mm.
Obtain disks containing different particle sizes: M 500, M 300, M 100.
Pile up M 500, M 300, and M 100 inside the cylindrical mold.
Compression-mold the stacked layers at 210 °C for 60 sec at ambient pressure and then at 180 bar for 3 minutes while maintaining the pressure of 180 bar.
Cool the resulting structure to room temperature under pressure of 180 bar.
Place the disks in a boiling demineralized water bath without stirring.
Remove the structures from the bath after 3 hours.
Dry the porous structures for 12 hours at room temperature in a chemical hood.
Evaluate scaffold morphologies by scanning electron microscopy.
Break down samples under liquid nitrogen.
Attach samples on an aluminum stub using adhesive carbon tape.
Sputter-coat the samples with gold for 90 seconds under argon atmosphere.
Elaborate images obtained by SEM analysis with an image processing software to recognize pore size distribution of the scaffold.
Weigh the samples before leaching and evaluate theoretical porosity according to provided expression.
Weigh the samples after leaching and drying to assess apparent density of the samples.
Evaluate real porosity using reciprocal ratio between apparent density of the scaffold and density of non-porous PLA.
Test the samples under compressive mode using a tensile machine equipped with a 1 kN load cell.
Set a constant strain rate of 1 mm min-1 during mechanical properties testing.
Equip the dynamometer with a bath containing PBS (pH = 7.4) at 37 °C.
Soak samples in PBS in a vacuum flask for 5 min before each measurement in wet environment.
Allow scaffolds to remain in PBS at 37 °C for 15 min to reach set-point temperature.
Fix the scaffold on the rig and ensure correct alignment with the machine's load cell and base platen.
Attach scaffold samples to aluminum test stubs using high viscosity adhesive.
Place samples into equipment for testing.
Hydrate samples in PBS for 1 hr prior to wet condition testing.
Use a 1 kN load cell under tensile load applied at a strain rate of 1 mm min-1.
